candidates.title: Audit adverse exposure before the nearer call is acquired
candidates.rationale: A better short-sale entry is economically useful only alongside the exposure carried before conversion or cover. The current round has no exact-quote path evidence, and aggregate flow cannot bound a right-tail rally.
candidates.falsification: For the frozen initial entries, reconstruct every available minute's short-cover cost, underlying rally and far-call delta through conversion or the common exit. Report missing intervals and quote-age limitations. A profit advantage accompanied by larger sampled losses or unknown exposure cannot establish reduced short-phase risk.
candidates.decision_impact: Expose whether apparent timing value is compensation for carrying more short-call risk, and determine which cases support only quoted-price diagnostics.

candidates.title: Compare financed conversion with immediate purchase and same-minute short cover
candidates.rationale: A credit remaining after construction is not the value added by purchasing the nearer call. Only controls sharing the initial short sale can isolate the second decision.
candidates.falsification: Replay the fixed next-session conversion policy against immediate spread purchase and covering the short at conversion, using identical D4 deadlines, all fees, fixed-timestamp one-cent/two-cent costs and preserved failed or censored attempts. Nonpositive incremental net wealth against either primary control fails the corresponding economic comparison; fewer than twenty dates remains statistically inconclusive.
candidates.decision_impact: Determine whether the nearer call adds measured value, merely finances a position, or consumes premium that an immediate short cover would preserve.
